```{=html}
<script>
// The card of each presentation with cells shows the state of its Julia process, as the playground's server answers
// it. A presentation without cells starts no process, and its card shows no state.
(() => {
  const cells = {};
  const update = async () => {
    try {
      const states = await (await fetch('/api/presentations')).json();
      for (const link of document.querySelectorAll('a.quarto-grid-link')) {
        const name = link.getAttribute('href').match(/presentations\/([^/]+)\//)?.[1];
        const body = link.querySelector('.card-body');
        if (!states[name] || !body) continue;
        cells[name] ??= (await (await fetch('presentations/' + name + '/cells.json')).json()).length;
        if (!cells[name]) continue;
        const mark = body.querySelector('output') ?? body.appendChild(document.createElement('output'));
        mark.dataset.state = states[name].state;
        mark.textContent = 'Julia ' + states[name].state;
      }
    } catch (_) { /* Without the playground's server, the cards do not show a state. */ }
  };
  update();
  setInterval(update, 2000);
})();
</script>
```
